parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the toilet is a flat, hinged cover made of plastic, typically circular or oval in shape, fitting over the seat.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover the toilet bowl when not in use, preventing odors and maintaining hygiene.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward and downward around a hinge attached to the seat.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: The seat is a ring-shaped component made of plastic, designed to provide a comfortable sitting surface on the toilet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user while sitting and provides a hygienic interface between the user and the toilet bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward and downward around the hinge connecting it to the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main structure of the toilet, made of ceramic, including the bowl and the tank.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and lid, holds water for flushing, and channels waste into the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor and connected to the water and waste systems.
